quotations.old_english: Byrhtnóþ bræd bill of scéðe, brád and brúnecg
quotations.english: Byrhtnoth drew his battle-axe from its sheath, broad and brown of edge

source_text: brún-ecg; adj. [brún brown, ecg an edge] Brown-edged; nigra acie præditus :-- Byrhtnóþ bræd bill of scéðe, brád and brúnecg Byrhtnoth drew his battle-axe from its sheath, broad and brown of edge, Byrht. Th. 136, 38; By. 163: Beo. Th. 3096; B. 1546.
